name: Claire - Protein Granola Cookie V3
master_prompt: Fast native American TikTok UGC with one coherent Claire identity and female voice. Use a provocative grocery-label comparison, not fearmongering. No fake brands, baked captions, or medical claims.

hooks.title: Protein granola is a cookie
hooks.script: That protein granola can be a cookie with better marketing.
hooks.prompt: Scroll-stopping supermarket cereal-aisle selfie. Claire holds a generic granola bag beside a large cookie, both too close to the lens, intense disbelieving expression, imperfect fluorescent lighting, no readable brand. Native dialogue exactly once: That protein granola can be a cookie with better marketing.

segments.script: A protein claim on the front does not tell you how much is in a serving.
segments.prompt: Claire points at a generic, non-legible front-of-bag protein callout and immediately flips the granola bag around. Real grocery UGC, no fake readable label. Native dialogue exactly once: A protein claim on the front does not tell you how much is in a serving.

segments.script: First check serving size, because the bowl is usually much bigger.
segments.prompt: Top-down kitchen counter shot: Claire pours one measured generic granola serving into a tiny bowl beside a realistically larger breakfast bowl. Natural hands and gravity. Native dialogue exactly once: First check serving size, because the bowl is usually much bigger.

segments.script: Then compare added sugar to protein. That ratio tells the real story.
segments.prompt: Close phone shot of two generic nutrition panels intentionally too soft to read while Claire's fingers point between sugar and protein areas. No fabricated numbers. Native dialogue exactly once: Then compare added sugar to protein. That ratio tells the real story.

segments.script: I use plain yogurt, berries, seeds, and granola as the topping, not the meal.
segments.prompt: Medium lived-in kitchen shot. Claire makes a realistic bowl with plain yogurt, berries and seeds, finishing with a small granola sprinkle. Same identity, quick purposeful motion. Native dialogue exactly once: I use plain yogurt, berries, seeds, and granola as the topping, not the meal.

ctas.title: Comment LABEL
ctas.script: Comment LABEL and I will send the three numbers I compare.
ctas.prompt: Claire holds up three fingers beside the finished bowl and looks directly into the phone lens. Same kitchen and outfit. Native dialogue exactly once: Comment LABEL and I will send the three numbers I compare.
